schema: R15c follow-up 2 calibration gate (FR-181, FR-183; Maintainer decision D-82, 2026-10-21)
status: pre-registered before any run of this file: 400 fresh lasso replicates of the leave-pair-out null, with seeds disjoint from every earlier calibration; the earlier 100-replicate lasso FAIL (R15c/followup) stays recorded and is not pooled with these replicates

lpo_null.scenario: null, LOOCV scheme with the leave-pair-out AUC estimator (lasso)
lpo_null.rule: |mean - 0.5| <= 0.03 and mean + 1.96 SE <= 0.53 on the leave-pair-out AUC
lpo_null.source: FR-183 (a), unchanged; the replicate count is raised from 100 to 400 (D-82)

design.lpo: identical to R15c/followup: 12 vs 12 biological units, 200 pure-noise features; leave-pair-out over every positive x negative unit pair; inner 3-fold tuning; top-5 by AUC on the training data

seeds.family_offset: +1000 x family index (lasso 1), as in the R15c pre-registration
